arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export CODEX_HOME=/home/ubuntu/.codex
export PATH=/home/ubuntu/codex-agent/node_modules/.bin:$PATH
unset OPENAI_API_KEY CODEX_API_KEY OPENAI_BASE_URL
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,shutil,time,tomllib
from pathlib import Path
exe=shutil.which('codex')
if not exe or not Path(exe).is_file():raise RuntimeError('BLOCKER CODEX_CLI_NOT_FOUND')
p=subprocess.run([exe,'login','status'],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
assert p.returncode==0 and 'Logged in using ChatGPT' in (p.stdout+p.stderr),'BLOCKER NO_CHATGPT_LOGIN'
config=Path(os.environ['CODEX_HOME'])/'config.toml'
if config.exists():
 data=tomllib.loads(config.read_text())
 assert data.get('model_provider','openai')=='openai','BLOCKER NON_OFFICIAL_PROVIDER'
 print('CODEX_PROVIDER_CHATGPT_PASS')
source_sha='902079f6559880eaab8e6948b7c125c5b486de1c'
repository='martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex'
branch='fix/rea-codex-worker-env-20261030'
root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rea-plcodex-parallel-certified-',dir='/tmp'))
root.chmod(0o700)
print('PRIVATE_TEST_CREATED',root.name,flush=True)
try:
 src=root/'source'
 subprocess.run(['git','clone','--quiet','--depth','3','--branch',branch,'https://github.com/'+repository+'.git',str(src)],check=True,timeout=80,capture_output=True)
 head=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
 assert head==source_sha,'BLOCKER REPO_SHA_DRIFT'
 print('HEAD_VERIFIED',head,flush=True)
 paths=['codex/tests/rea_parallel_first_20261030.txt','codex/tests/rea_parallel_second_20261030.txt']
 items=[]
 for i,(name,expected) in enumerate(zip(paths,['PARALLEL_CODEX_FIRST_OK','PARALLEL_CODEX_SECOND_OK'])):
  task=('Implement a minimal isolated coordinator verification artifact only inside the file '+name+
  '. The file must contain exactly '+expected+' followed by a newline and nothing else. '+
  'Inspect the target checkout as needed and validate the exact content, but do not modify any other path, and do not create Git commits or publish changes. '+
  'This worker has one independently scoped and complete deliverable.')
  items.append({'id':'vps-parallel-'+str(i+1),'task':task,'paths':[name],'reasoning_effort':'medium'})
 order={'request':'Execute one genuine bounded Coordinator order with two separately scoped Codex CLI workers, to verify real parallel execution within the disposable Project-leader-codex checkout.',
        'target_repository':repository,'work_items':items,'preference':'auto'}
 order_path=root/'order.json'
 order_path.write_text(json.dumps(order)+'\n')
 env=dict(os.environ)
 plan=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','codex.smart','plan','--order',str(order_path),'--repo-dir',str(src)],cwd=src,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=35)
 if plan.returncode:print('PLAN_ERROR_CODE',plan.returncode,'STDERR',plan.stderr[:200]);raise RuntimeError('PLAN_FAILED')
 planned=json.loads(plan.stdout)
 print('COORDINATOR_MODE',planned.get('mode'),'COUNT',planned.get('agent_count'),'STATUS',planned.get('status'),flush=True)
 assert planned['status']=='planned' and planned['mode']=='parallel' and planned['agent_count']==2,'COORDINATOR_DID_NOT_SELECT_PARALLEL'
 selected=[{'id':t['id'],'provider':t['selection']['provider'],'adapter':t['selection']['adapter'],'model':t['selection']['model'],'effort':t['selection']['reasoning_effort']} for t in planned['tasks']]
 assert all(t['provider']=='codex' and t['adapter']=='codex-cli' for t in selected),'WRONG_PROVIDER'
 print('PROVIDERS',json.dumps(selected),flush=True)
 runs=root/'runs'
 runs.mkdir(mode=0o700)
 start=time.monotonic()
 proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','codex.smart','run','--order',str(order_path),'--repo-dir',str(src),'--runs-dir',str(runs),'--timeout','165','--execute'],cwd=src,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=230)
 duration=round(time.monotonic()-start,2)
 print('RUN_EXIT',proc.returncode,'WALL_SECONDS',duration,flush=True)
 if proc.returncode:
  print('RUN_STDERR',proc.stderr[-1250:].replace('\n','|'))
  print('RUN_STDOUT',proc.stdout[-1750:].replace('\n','|'))
  raise RuntimeError('CODEX_PARALLEL_RUN_NOT_SUCCESS')
 result=json.loads(proc.stdout)
 workers=result.get('workers') or []
 assert result.get('mode')=='parallel' and len(workers)==2,'PARALLEL_RESULT_INCONSISTENT'
 assert all(w.get('status')=='completed' and w.get('exit_code')==0 for w in workers),'WORKER_FAILED'
 assert len({w['workspace'] for w in workers})==2,'WORKSPACES_NOT_ISOLATED'
 assert all(w.get('out_of_scope')==[] and w.get('ref_changes')==[] and not w.get('commit_detected') for w in workers),'SCOPE_OR_REF_VIOLATION'
 allpaths=sorted(p for w in workers for p in w.get('new_paths',[]))
 assert allpaths==sorted(paths),'CHANGED_PATHS_WRONG'
 total_worker_seconds=sum(w.get('duration_seconds',0) for w in workers)
 lowerbound=round(total_worker_seconds-duration,2)
 assert lowerbound>=3.0,'PARALLEL_OVERLAP_NOT_PROVEN'
 for idx,w in enumerate(workers):
  marker=Path(w['workspace'])/paths[idx]
  expected=('PARALLEL_CODEX_'+('FIRST' if idx==0 else 'SECOND')+'_OK\n').encode()
  assert marker.is_file() and marker.read_bytes()==expected,'MARKER_NOT_VERIFIED'
  events=[]
  log=Path(result['run_directory'])/(w['id']+'.jsonl')
  for line in log.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
   try:events.append(json.loads(line))
   except ValueError:pass
  tids=[e.get('thread_id') for e in events if e.get('type')=='thread.started' and e.get('thread_id')]
  completed=[e for e in events if e.get('type')=='turn.completed']
  assert tids and completed,'REAL_CODEX_EVENTS_MISSING'
  usage=completed[-1].get('usage') or {}
  print('WORKER',idx+1,'ID',w['id'],'CODEX_SESSION_ID',tids[0],
   'DURATION_SECONDS',w.get('duration_seconds'),'PATH',w['new_paths'][0],
   'INPUT_TOKENS',usage.get('input_tokens','UNKNOWN'),
   'OUTPUT_TOKENS',usage.get('output_tokens','UNKNOWN'),flush=True)
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'status','--porcelain'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
 assert not p.stdout.strip(),'SOURCE_WAS_MUTATED'
 print('REAL_PARALLEL_OVERLAP_LOWER_BOUND_SECONDS',lowerbound,flush=True)
 print('TEST_NO_MAIN_CHANGE_NO_PUSH_PASS',flush=True)
 print('LIVE_TWO_CODEX_WORKERS_PASS',flush=True)
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(root)
 print('PRIVATE_TEST_CLEANUP_COMPLETE',flush=True)
PY
